body.message:
Hello Brian,

We hope you are doing well.

We have received an update from the owner that they would like to replace the curtains in the apartment.
The curtain replacement team would like to visit the unit tomorrow, 22nd July, between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM.

Could you please confirm if this timing works for you so we can schedule the visit accordingly?

Thank you for your cooperation.
